text: in that thou lovest: Heb. by loving, etc. | that thou regardest neither princes, nor servants: Heb. that princes or servants are not to thee
comfortably unto thy servants: Heb. to the heart of thy servants
speak ye not a word: Heb. are ye silent?
what he thought good: Heb. the good in his eyes
dead men: Heb. men of death
How long have I to live: How many days are the years of my life?
despise us: Heb. set us at light
